description: This file defines a controller class 'SubTotal' for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for managing the 'Subtotal' total component. It includes methods to display the configuration page ('index') and save settings ('save'), interacting with the OpenCart framework's language, URL, configuration, and response systems.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Controller class for managing the SubTotal total extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the SubTotal configuration page, including setting up breadcrumbs, page title, fetching configuration, and loading views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the SubTotal extension, including permission check, saving data, and returning JSON response.
